::: {.hero-banner}
## Three policy briefs. One system. {.hero-title}

**Strengthen detection. Close the response loop. Act on the worst product first.**
:::

## The headline numbers

| Indicator | Value | Source |
|:----------|------:|:-------|
| True annual burden (cases) | **11,690** | NMC + NHLS + PIH |
| Headline annual deaths | **1,500** | Stratified CFR + VR triangulation |
| Annual economic burden | **R2.34 billion** | Morbidity (R90M) + mortality (R2.25B) |
| Health-sector share (NDoH + NHLS) | **~R80M (3.4 %)** | Direct budget-line cost |
| Household / societal share | **~R2.26B (96.6 %)** | OOP + lost lifetime earnings |

: All numbers pulled from the canonical [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.qmd) — single source of truth. {.striped}

## The three briefs

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### 1 · [Detect](posts/surveillance_policy.qmd)

**Surveillance brief.** Close the gap between NMC, NHLS, and PIH so cases are seen in days, not weeks.

**MVP — R157k/year, +73 % detection, 12 weeks.**
NHLS→NMC feed + BChE auto-notify + PIH dashboard/MVD.

*Audience: NDoH, NICD, NHLS, MAC.*
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### 2 · [Act](posts/coordination_policy.qmd)

**Coordination brief.** Make every NMC notification trigger a recorded EHP investigation and a DALRRD-acknowledged referral.

**Full Package — R145k/year, ~957 deaths averted/year.**
Closure-of-loop field + structured DALRRD referral + NICD→DALRRD intelligence feed + clinician feedback + joint KPI dashboard.

*Audience: NDoH + DALRRD DGs, MAC, Treasury.*
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### 3 · [Restrict](posts/terbufos_policy.qmd)

**Terbufos brief.** Act on the WHO Class Ia product that drives a disproportionate share of fatal pesticide poisonings.

**Option T2 now, 24-month evaluation gate to T3 (full ban).**
DALRRD-led; ~R1–3M/year of enforcement retires household-borne mortality cost at a leverage ratio of ~1 : 500.

*Audience: DALRRD Pesticide Registrar, MAC, NDoH.*
:::

:::

## How the three briefs work as one system

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-golden-thread
%%| fig-cap: "Golden thread of the D2P briefs. Better detection generates the evidence the coordination loop needs; the closed loop terminates in product-specific regulatory action; outcomes of that action are picked up by the same surveillance system that started the chain."
flowchart LR
    S[1 · Detect<br/><b>Surveillance</b><br/>NMC + NHLS + PIH] --> C[2 · Act<br/><b>Coordination</b><br/>NICD → EHP → DALRRD]
    C --> R[3 · Restrict<br/><b>Terbufos</b><br/>RUP → 24-month gate → ban]
    R -.Outcome<br/>feedback.-> S

    style S fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style C fill:#9f9,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style R fill:#ffd9b3,stroke:#cc8800,stroke-width:2px
```

Three stages, one system. Each affordable on its own; each strictly more valuable paired with the others. **Total annual operating cost ~R300k against an annual burden of R2.34 billion.**

## What this site does *not* claim

- **A new legislative ask.** Every recommendation is implementable under existing authority (NHA §90; Act 36 of 1947).
- **Unsourced numbers.** Every figure traces back to [`amua_import_parameters_v3.csv`](amua_import_parameters_v3.csv) and the references in the [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.qmd).
- **A single point estimate masquerading as certainty.** Headline numbers are anchored to ranges; open evidence gaps are listed explicitly.
